import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from shaderlod_host.benchmark import (
    CommandIncomplete,
    WorkflowPlan,
    import_capture,
    session_command,
)
from shaderlod_host.contracts import decode_request, verify_source
from shaderlod_host.runtime import execute, verify_result, recover_execution


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Bounded execution, frame capture and offline analysis; qualification is explicit"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "mode",
        choices=[
            "plan",
            "run",
            "verify",
            "report",
            "doctor",
            "recover",
            "profile",
            "compare",
            "session-open",
            "session-status",
            "session-close",
            "session-recover",
            "prepare-windows",
            "prepare-profile",
            "prepare-world",
            "freeze-windows-runtime",
            "qualify",
            "validate",
            "history",
            "installation",
        ],
    )
    parser.add_argument("--request", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--spec", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--policy", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--runs", type=Path, nargs="+")
    parser.add_argument("--review", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--ancestor-pid", type=int, help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--ancestor-birth", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--probe-worker", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--frames", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--session", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--launch", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--world", default="ShaderLOD-Smoke")
    parser.add_argument("--display", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=180)
    parser.add_argument("--wait-ready", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--telemetry", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--without-shaderlod", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--ownership-root", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--control", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--reserve-bytes", type=int, default=67108864)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if (args.ancestor_pid is None) != (args.ancestor_birth is None):
        parser.error("internal ancestry requires both process ID and birth identity")
    if args.resume and (args.mode != "qualify" or args.spec is None):
        parser.error(
            "--resume requires qualify --spec for an unfinished frozen campaign"
        )
    if (
        args.mode in {"qualify", "history"}
        and args.result is not None
        and not args.runs
    ):
        from shaderlod_host.campaign import campaign_results

        args.runs = campaign_results(args.result.parent)
    if args.mode == "installation":
        from shaderlod_host.comparison import ComparisonPlan, installation_plan
        from shaderlod_host.runtime_live import execute_installation

        if args.spec is None:
            parser.error("installation requires --spec")
        installation = ComparisonPlan.decode(json.loads(args.spec.read_bytes()))
        resolved_installation = installation_plan(installation)
        if args.plan:
            print(json.dumps(resolved_installation, sort_keys=True))
            return 0
        if (
            args.launch is None
            or args.profile is None
            or args.display is None
            or args.ownership_root is None
            or args.output_root is None
        ):
            parser.error(
                "installation requires --launch --profile --display --ownership-root --output-root"
            )
        result = execute_installation(
            installation,
            args.launch,
            args.profile,
            args.display,
            args.ownership_root,
            args.output_root,
            args.world,
        )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != "observations"},
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
        return 0 if result["state"] == "complete" else 1
    if args.mode == "history":
        from shaderlod_host.reports import history

        if not args.runs or args.output_root is None:
            parser.error("history requires --runs --output-root")
        result = history(args.runs, args.output_root)
        groups = result["groups"]
        failures = result["failures"]
        if not isinstance(groups, dict) or not isinstance(failures, list):
            raise ValueError("invalid history output")
        print(json.dumps({"series": len(groups), "failures": len(failures)}))
        return 0
    if args.mode == "validate":
        from shaderlod_host.validation import validation_spec, validate_session

        if args.spec is None or args.session is None or args.output_root is None:
            parser.error("validate requires --spec --session --output-root")
        surface, dh_enabled = validation_spec(json.loads(args.spec.read_bytes()))
        result = validate_session(args.session, args.output_root, surface, dh_enabled)
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    k: v
                    for k, v in result.items()
                    if k not in {"functional", "session_identity"}
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
        return 0 if result["outcome"] == "PASS" else 1
    if args.mode == "qualify":
        from shaderlod_host.assessment import QualificationPolicy, assess
        from shaderlod_host.storage import publish

        if args.spec is not None:
            from shaderlod_host.campaign import Campaign
            from shaderlod_host.runtime_live import execute_campaign

            campaign = Campaign.decode(json.loads(args.spec.read_bytes()))
            if args.plan:
                print(json.dumps(campaign.describe(), sort_keys=True))
                return 0
            if (
                args.launch is None
                or args.profile is None
                or args.display is None
                or args.ownership_root is None
                or args.output_root is None
            ):
                parser.error(
                    "campaign requires --launch --profile --display --ownership-root --output-root"
                )
            result = execute_campaign(
                campaign,
                args.launch,
                args.profile,
                args.display,
                args.ownership_root,
                args.output_root,
                args.world,
                args.resume,
                args.control,
            )
            print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
            return 0 if result["state"] == "complete" else 1
        if args.policy is None or not args.runs or args.output_root is None:
            parser.error("qualify requires --policy --runs --output-root")
        policy = QualificationPolicy.decode(json.loads(args.policy.read_bytes()))
        review = None if args.review is None else json.loads(args.review.read_bytes())
        result = assess(policy, args.runs, review)
        publish(args.output_root / "assessment.json", result)
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
        return 0 if result["recommendation"] == "meets_declared_policy" else 1
    if args.mode == "freeze-windows-runtime":
        if args.source_root is None or args.output_root is None:
            parser.error("freeze-windows-runtime requires --source-root --output-root")
        from shaderlod_host.runtime_live import freeze_windows_runtime

        print(
            json.dumps(
                freeze_windows_runtime(
                    args.source_root,
                    args.output_root,
                    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1],
                ),
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
        return 0
    if args.mode == "prepare-world":
        from shaderlod_host.storage import BusyRefusal, prepare_world
        import socket

        if (
            args.source_root is None
            or args.profile is None
            or args.output_root is None
            or args.spec is None
            or args.ownership_root is None
        ):
            parser.error(
                "prepare-world requires --source-root --profile --world --spec --output-root --ownership-root"
            )
        if (
            not args.world
            or args.world in {".", ".."}
            or "/" in args.world
            or "\\" in args.world
        ):
            raise ValueError("single prepared world name required")
        with BusyRefusal(args.ownership_root, socket.gethostname() + ":gpu:0"):
            prepared = prepare_world(
                args.source_root,
                args.profile / "saves" / args.world,
                args.output_root,
                json.loads(args.spec.read_bytes()),
            )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {key: value for key, value in prepared.items() if key != "files"},
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
        return 0
    if args.mode == "prepare-profile":
        from shaderlod_host.storage import BusyRefusal, prepare_primary_profile
        import socket

        if (
            args.profile is None
            or args.output_root is None
            or args.ownership_root is None
        ):
            parser.error(
                "prepare-profile requires --profile --output-root --ownership-root"
            )
        pin = json.loads(
            (
                args.spec
                if args.spec is not None
                else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
                / "dependencies/primary-pack.json"
            ).read_bytes()
        )
        with BusyRefusal(args.ownership_root, socket.gethostname() + ":gpu:0"):
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    prepare_primary_profile(
                        args.profile, pin["filename"], pin["sha256"], args.output_root
                    ),
                    sort_keys=True,
                )
            )
        return 0
    if args.mode == "prepare-windows":
        if args.source_root is None or args.profile is None:
            parser.error(
                "--source-root legacy runtime and --profile canonical profile required"
            )
        from shaderlod_host.runtime_live import prepare_windows_runtime

        print(
            json.dumps(
                prepare_windows_runtime(
                    args.source_root, args.profile, Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
                ),
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
        return 0
    if args.mode == "doctor":
        if args.probe_worker:
            if args.output_root is None:
                parser.error("--output-root required for watchdog probe")
            from shaderlod_host.worker import probe_worker

            result = probe_worker(args.output_root)
            print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
            return 0 if result["pass"] else 1
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "schema": "shaderlod-doctor-v1",
                    "cpu_runner": "implemented"
                    if sys.platform == "linux"
                    else "unavailable",
                    "platform": sys.platform,
                    "live_runner": "Linux/native Windows; explicit allocation and runtime receipts required",
                    "current_renderer_qualification": "not inspected by doctor",
                    "benchmark_methodology": "implemented; qualification is result- and configuration-scoped",
                    "python": sys.version.split()[0],
                }
            )
        )
        return 0
    if args.mode in {
        "session-open",
        "session-status",
        "session-close",
        "session-recover",
    }:
        try:
            if args.session is None:
                parser.error("--session required")
            if args.mode in {"session-status", "session-close", "session-recover"}:
                if args.mode == "session-status" and args.wait_ready:
                    from shaderlod_host.benchmark import wait_ready

                    observed = wait_ready(args.session, args.timeout)
                    print(json.dumps(observed, sort_keys=True))
                    return 0
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        session_command(
                            args.session,
                            {
                                "session-close": "close",
                                "session-status": "status",
                                "session-recover": "recover",
                            }[args.mode],
                            0,
                            5
                            if args.mode == "session-status"
                            else min(65, args.timeout),
                        ),
                        sort_keys=True,
                    )
                )
                return 0
            if (
                args.launch is None
                or args.profile is None
                or args.display is None
                or args.ownership_root is None
            ):
                parser.error(
                    "session-open requires --launch --profile --display --ownership-root"
                )
            from shaderlod_host.runtime_live import benchmark_session

            return benchmark_session(
                args.launch,
                args.profile,
                args.display,
                args.session,
                args.ownership_root,
                args.timeout,
                args.world,
                None
                if args.ancestor_pid is None
                else (args.ancestor_pid, args.ancestor_birth),
                args.telemetry,
                args.without_shaderlod,
            )
        except CommandIncomplete as error:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "incomplete", "reason": str(error)}))
            return 1
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
            return 2
    if args.mode in {"profile", "compare"} or args.frames is not None:
        try:
            if args.frames is not None:
                if args.mode != "report" or args.output_root is None:
                    parser.error("frame import requires report --frames --output-root")
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        import_capture(args.frames, args.output_root), sort_keys=True
                    )
                )
                return 0
            if args.spec is None:
                parser.error("--spec required")
            specification = json.loads(args.spec.read_bytes())
            if (
                isinstance(specification, dict)
                and specification.get("schema") == "shaderlod-comparison-v1"
            ):
                from shaderlod_host.comparison import ComparisonPlan, execute_comparison

                comparison = ComparisonPlan.decode(specification)
                if args.mode != "compare":
                    raise ValueError(
                        "comparison specification requires compare command"
                    )
                if args.plan:
                    print(json.dumps(comparison.describe(), sort_keys=True))
                    return 0
                if args.session is None or args.output_root is None:
                    parser.error("comparison requires --session --output-root")
                comparison_policy = (
                    None
                    if args.policy is None
                    else json.loads(args.policy.read_bytes())
                )
                result = execute_comparison(
                    comparison, args.session, args.output_root, policy=comparison_policy
                )
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            key: value
                            for key, value in result.items()
                            if key not in {"observations", "baselines"}
                        },
                        sort_keys=True,
                    )
                )
                return 0 if result["state"] == "complete" else 1
            plan = WorkflowPlan.decode(specification)
            if (args.mode == "profile") != (plan.scope == "profile"):
                raise ValueError("command disagrees with workflow scope")
            if (
                not args.plan
                and args.mode == "profile"
                and args.session is not None
                and args.output_root is not None
            ):
                if len(plan.arms) != 1 or plan.blocks != 1:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "only single fixed-scene frame captures are currently supported"
                    )
                if args.output_root.exists():
                    raise ValueError("fresh profile output required before capture")
                payload = None
                if plan.instrument == "diagnostic":
                    status = session_command(args.session, "status", 0, 5)
                    pose = status.get("pose")
                    if not isinstance(pose, list) or len(pose) != 5:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "ready player pose required for diagnostic profile"
                        )
                    payload = {
                        "from": pose,
                        "to": pose,
                        "delay_ms": 0,
                        "diagnostic": True,
                    }
                observed = session_command(
                    args.session,
                    "capture",
                    plan.window_ms,
                    min(310, plan.budget_ms / 1000),
                    payload,
                )
                from shaderlod_host.benchmark import save_live_capture

                try:
                    summary = save_live_capture(observed, args.output_root)
                except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
                    from shaderlod_host.storage import publish

                    publish(
                        args.output_root / "failure.json",
                        {
                            "schema": "shaderlod-profile-failure-v1",
                            "state": "incomplete",
                            "reason": str(error),
                            "session": str(args.session),
                            "sequence": observed.get("sequence"),
                        },
                    )
                    raise CommandIncomplete(
                        "capture rejected; raw acknowledgement and failure receipt preserved"
                    ) from error
                print(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))
                return 0 if summary["valid"] is True else 1
            if not args.plan:
                raise ValueError(
                    "live benchmark execution is not yet implemented; use --plan"
                )
            print(json.dumps(plan.describe(), sort_keys=True))
            return 0
        except CommandIncomplete as error:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "incomplete", "reason": str(error)}))
            return 1
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
            return 2
    if args.mode == "verify" and args.request is None and args.result is not None:
        from shaderlod_host.benchmark import verify_frame_receipt

        try:
            kind = json.loads(args.result.read_bytes()).get("schema")
            if kind == "shaderlod-installation-result-v1":
                from shaderlod_host.comparison import verify_installation

                verified = verify_installation(args.result)
                print(json.dumps({"integrity": "PASS", "state": verified["state"]}))
                return 0
            print(json.dumps(verify_frame_receipt(args.result), sort_keys=True))
            return 0
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
            return 2
    if args.request is None:
        parser.error("--request required")
    try:
        request = decode_request(json.loads(args.request.read_bytes()))
        if args.mode == "recover":
            if args.output_root is None or args.ownership_root is None:
                parser.error("--output-root and --ownership-root required")
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    recover_execution(request, args.output_root, args.ownership_root),
                    sort_keys=True,
                )
            )
            return 0
        if args.mode in {"verify", "report"}:
            if args.result is None:
                parser.error("--result required")
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    verify_result(json.loads(args.result.read_bytes()), request),
                    sort_keys=True,
                )
            )
            return 0
        if args.source_root is None:
            parser.error("--source-root required")
        verify_source(args.source_root, request.source)
        if args.mode == "plan":
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "schema": "shaderlod-plan-v1",
                        "request": request.identity,
                        "purpose": request.purpose,
                        "argv": request.argv,
                        "budget_ms": request.cumulative_ms,
                        "activation": "not observed",
                        "evidence_scope": "CPU process integration only",
                    }
                )
            )
            return 0
        if args.output_root is None or args.ownership_root is None:
            parser.error("--output-root and --ownership-root required")
        result = execute(
            request,
            args.source_root,
            args.output_root,
            args.ownership_root,
            args.control,
            args.reserve_bytes,
        )
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
        return 0 if result["state"] == "complete" else 1
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except CommandIncomplete as error:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "incomplete", "reason": str(error)}))
        sys.exit(1)
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "refused", "reason": str(error)}))
        sys.exit(2)

def rebuild(source: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.benchmark import read_frames, render_frames
    from shaderlod_host.comparison import verify_comparison, render_comparison

    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("fresh report output required")
    record = json.loads(source.read_bytes())
    kind = record.get("schema")
    if kind == "shaderlod-frame-capture-v1":
        verify_frame_receipt(source)
        summary = json.loads((source.parent / "summary.json").read_bytes())
        rendered = render_frames(read_frames(source.parent / "frames.jsonl"), summary)
        publish(output / "summary.json", summary)
    elif kind == "shaderlod-comparison-result-v1":
        record = verify_comparison(source)
        view = json.loads(json.dumps(record))
        for row in view["observations"]:
            row["attempt"] = (source.parent / row["attempt"]).resolve().as_uri()
        rendered = render_comparison(view)
        publish_bytes(output / "result.json", source.read_bytes())
    elif kind == "shaderlod-campaign-result-v1":
        from shaderlod_host.campaign import campaign_results

        return history(campaign_results(source.parent), output)
    else:
        raise ValueError("completed capture/comparison or campaign result required")
    publish_bytes(output / "report.html", rendered.encode())
    manifest: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-derived-report-v1",
        "source": str(source.resolve()),
        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "renderer_sha256": {
            path.name: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for path in (
                Path(__file__),
                *Path(__file__).with_name("templates").glob("*.html"),
            )
        },
        "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(rendered.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "limits": "Offline derivative; no new evidence or qualification. Linked raw assets remain at their preserved source location.",
    }
    publish(output / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

from shaderlod_host.config import (
    display_environment,
    evidence_root,
    worker_environment,
)
from shaderlod_host.functional_contract import verify_functional
from shaderlod_host.storage import (
    BusyRefusal,
    publish,
    profile_artifact,
)
from shaderlod_host.worker import birth, boot


def executable_inputs(
    launch: dict[str, object], root: Path, profile: Path | None = None
) -> dict[str, str]:
    paths: set[Path] = set()
    pending = list(launch["argv"]) if isinstance(launch["argv"], list) else []
    visited: set[str] = set()
    while pending:
        token = str(pending.pop())
        if token.startswith("@") and token not in visited:
            visited.add(token)
            path = Path(token[1:])
            paths.add(path)
            pending.extend(shlex.split(path.read_text(), comments=True))
        else:
            for piece in token.split(os.pathsep):
                path = Path(piece)
                if path.is_absolute() and path.is_file():
                    paths.add(path)
    legacy = root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt"
    paths.add(legacy)
    paths.update(Path(line) for line in legacy.read_text().splitlines() if line)
    paths.update((root / "shaderlod_host").glob("*.py"))
    if profile is not None:
        paths.update((profile / "mods").glob("*.jar"))
    for directory in [
        root / "build/classes/java",
        root / "build/resources",
        root / "dependencies/runtime",
    ]:
        paths.update(path for path in directory.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
    return {
        str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for path in sorted(paths)
        if path.is_file()
    }


PROBE_OUTPUTS = (
    "shaderlod-functional.json",
    "shaderlod-functional.png",
    "shaderlod-functional-identity.png",
)


def preserve_outputs(profile: Path, destination: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    preserved: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name in PROBE_OUTPUTS:
        source = profile / name
        if source.is_file():
            destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            preserved[name] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            shutil.move(source, destination / name)
    return preserved


def read_functional(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object] | None, str | None]:
    try:
        observed = json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else None
        if observed is not None and not isinstance(observed, dict):
            raise ValueError("functional output must be an object")
        return observed, None
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        return None, str(error)


def attempt_receipt(requested: Path | None, repository: Path, mode: str) -> Path:
    if requested is None:
        stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
        requested = evidence_root() / "attempts" / f"{stamp}-{mode}.json"
    resolved = requested.resolve()
    if resolved.is_relative_to(repository.resolve()):
        raise ValueError(
            "receipts belong outside the repository; omit --receipt to use "
            + str(evidence_root() / "attempts")
        )
    if resolved.exists() or resolved.with_suffix("").exists():
        raise ValueError("receipt already exists; choose a new --receipt or omit it")
    resolved.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return resolved


def benchmark_session(
    launch_path: Path,
    profile: Path,
    display: Path,
    session: Path,
    ownership: Path,
    timeout: int,
    world: str = "ShaderLOD-Smoke",
) -> int:
    if sys.platform not in {"linux", "win32"} or not 1 <= timeout <= 14400:
        raise ValueError("Linux/Windows session with 1–14400 second deadline required")
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    if session.exists() or session.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("fresh external session directory required")
    if not world or world in {".", ".."} or "/" in world or "\\" in world:
        raise ValueError("single prepared world name required")
    if not profile.is_dir() or not (profile / "saves" / world).is_dir():
        raise ValueError("prepared profile and selected world required")
    launch = json.loads(launch_path.read_bytes())
    if not isinstance(launch.get("argv"), list) or not all(
        isinstance(a, str) for a in launch["argv"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("invalid launch argv")
    argv = list(launch["argv"])
    if "-cp" not in argv:
        raise ValueError("explicit classpath launch required")
    position = argv.index("-cp")
    argv[position:position] = [
        "-Dshaderlod.functionalProbe=false",
        "-Dshaderlod.benchmarkDirectory=" + str(session.resolve()),
    ]
    profile = profile.resolve(strict=True)
    shipping = Path(launch["shipping_jar"])
    import zipfile

    with zipfile.ZipFile(shipping) as archive:
        for compiled in (root / "build/classes/java/main").rglob("*.class"):
            member = compiled.relative_to(root / "build/classes/java/main").as_posix()
            if archive.read(member) != compiled.read_bytes():
                raise ValueError(
                    "shipping JAR differs from compiled sources; build jar before opening session"
                )
    environment = (
        worker_environment() if os.name == "nt" else display_environment(display)
    )
    environment.update(launch["environment"])
    with BusyRefusal(ownership, socket.gethostname() + ":gpu:0"):
        recover_profile_artifact(profile)
        session.mkdir(parents=True)
        found_world = False
        for index, token in enumerate(argv):
            if token.startswith("@"):
                args = shlex.split(Path(token[1:]).read_text(), comments=True)
                if "--quickPlaySingleplayer" in args:
                    position = args.index("--quickPlaySingleplayer") + 1
                    if position >= len(args):
                        raise ValueError("missing quick-play world argument")
                    args[position] = world
                    from shaderlod_host.storage import publish_bytes

                    frozen = session / "world-program-args.txt"
                    publish_bytes(
                        frozen,
                        (
                            "\n".join(
                                '"' + a.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
                                for a in args
                            )
                            + "\n"
                        ).encode(),
                    )
                    argv[index] = "@" + str(frozen)
                    found_world = True
        if not found_world:
            raise ValueError("launch must declare one quick-play world")
        launch = dict(launch, argv=argv)
        publish(session / "launch.json", launch)
        launch_path = session / "launch.json"
        with profile_artifact(profile, shipping, session):
            from shaderlod_host.storage import snapshot_inputs

            snapshot_inputs(root, session / "inputs.tar")
            before = executable_inputs(launch, root, profile)
            with (session / "client.log").open("xb") as log:
                worker = subprocess.Popen(
                    [
                        sys.executable,
                        "-m",
                        "shaderlod_host.worker",
                        str(time.monotonic() + timeout),
                        str(os.getpid()),
                        birth(os.getpid()),
                        json.dumps(argv),
                        str(session / "child.json"),
                        "session",
                    ],
                    cwd=profile,
                    env=worker_environment(environment),
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                )
                publish(
                    session / "session.json",
                    {
                        "schema": "shaderlod-session-v1",
                        "host": socket.gethostname(),
                        "boot": boot(),
                        "owner_pid": os.getpid(),
                        "owner_birth": birth(os.getpid()),
                        "profile": str(profile.resolve()),
                        "world": world,
                        "launch": str(launch_path.resolve()),
                        "executable_inputs": before,
                        "input_snapshot_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                            (session / "inputs.tar").read_bytes()
                        ).hexdigest(),
                        "timeout_seconds": timeout,
                        "capabilities": [
                            "status",
                            "capture",
                            "select",
                            "restore",
                            "prepare",
                            "screenshot",
                            "close",
                            "validate",
                            "recover",
                        ],
                        "qualification": "unqualified development session",
                        "child_record": str(session / "child.json"),
                    },
                )
                try:
                    telemetry_stop = threading.Event()
                    telemetry_errors: list[str] = []
                    telemetry = threading.Thread(
                        target=record_telemetry,
                        args=(session, telemetry_stop, telemetry_errors),
                        daemon=True,
                    )
                    telemetry.start()
                    try:
                        status = worker.wait(timeout=timeout + 5)
                    finally:
                        telemetry_stop.set()
                        telemetry.join(timeout=3)
                finally:
                    if worker.poll() is None:
                        worker.terminate()
                        worker.wait(timeout=3)
                unchanged = before == executable_inputs(launch, root, profile)
        publish(
            session / "closed.json",
            {
                "schema": "shaderlod-session-close-v1",
                "returncode": status,
                "inputs_unchanged": unchanged,
                "profile_artifact_restored": True,
                "telemetry_errors": telemetry_errors,
                "telemetry_stopped": not telemetry.is_alive(),
                "restoration": "profile artifact restored; shader/world state is established by acknowledged close and recovery journals",
                "shader_recovery_pending": (
                    profile / "shaderlod-recovery.json"
                ).exists(),
                "world_recovery_pending": (
                    profile / "shaderlod-benchmark-world.json"
                ).exists(),
            },
        )
        return status


def record_telemetry(
    session: Path, stopping: threading.Event, errors: list[str]
) -> None:
    from shaderlod_host.telemetry import NvidiaSensors, host_sample

    sensors = NvidiaSensors()
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    index = 0
    try:
        while not stopping.is_set():
            index += 1
            record = host_sample()
            record["schema"] = "shaderlod-telemetry-v1"
            record["elapsed_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns() - started
            record["unix_ns"] = time.time_ns()
            record["gpu"] = sensors.sample()
            publish(session / "telemetry" / (str(index) + ".json"), record)
            stopping.wait(1)
    except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError) as error:
        errors.append(str(error))
    finally:
        sensors.close()


def recover_profile_artifact(profile: Path) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    from shaderlod_host.storage import restore_profile_artifact

    marker = profile / "shaderlod-benchmark-profile.json"
    if not marker.exists():
        return None
    record = json.loads(marker.read_bytes())
    previous = Path(record["session"])
    metadata = json.loads((previous / "session.json").read_bytes())
    if (
        metadata.get("host") != socket.gethostname()
        or Path(metadata["profile"]).resolve() != profile.resolve()
    ):
        raise ValueError("foreign profile-artifact recovery owner")
    for pid, identity in [(metadata["owner_pid"], metadata["owner_birth"])]:
        if metadata["boot"] == boot():
            try:
                if birth(pid) == identity:
                    raise ValueError("profile-artifact owner is still live")
            except (OSError, ProcessLookupError):
                pass
    child = json.loads((previous / "child.json").read_bytes())
    if child.get("host") != metadata["host"] or child.get("boot") != metadata["boot"]:
        raise ValueError("profile recovery child identity disagreement")
    if child["boot"] == boot():
        try:
            if birth(child["pid"]) == child["birth"]:
                raise ValueError("owned client still live; profile recovery refused")
        except (OSError, ProcessLookupError):
            pass
    restore_profile_artifact(profile, record)
    outcome: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-profile-recovery-v1",
        "artifact_restored": True,
        "previous_session": str(previous),
        "world_journal_pending": (profile / "shaderlod-benchmark-world.json").exists(),
    }
    publish(previous / "profile-recovery.json", outcome)
    return outcome


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Bounded Asahi functional execution, no performance study"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--launch", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--without-dh", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--native-control", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--shipping-jar", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--display", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--ownership-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=180)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sys.platform != "linux" or not 1 <= args.timeout <= 600:
        parser.error("Linux and bounded 1–600 second timeout required")
    launch = json.loads(args.launch.read_bytes())
    argv = launch["argv"]
    if not isinstance(argv, list) or not all(isinstance(a, str) for a in argv):
        raise ValueError("invalid argument vector")
    if args.shipping_jar is not None:
        if args.native_control or args.shipping_jar.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError(
                "shipping probe requires a regular JAR and development probe"
            )
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        rewritten = []
        for item in argv:
            if item.startswith("-Dfml.modFolders="):
                entries = [
                    entry
                    for entry in item.split("=", 1)[1].split(":")
                    if not entry.startswith("shaderlod%%")
                ]
                rewritten.append("-Dfml.modFolders=" + ":".join(entries))
            else:
                rewritten.append(item)
        argv = rewritten
        if "-cp" in argv:
            position = argv.index("-cp") + 1
            excluded = {
                str(root / "build/classes/java/main"),
                str(root / "build/resources/main"),
            }
            argv[position] = ":".join(
                item for item in argv[position].split(":") if item not in excluded
            )
        launch["argv"] = argv
    if args.native_control:
        argv = [item for item in argv if not item.startswith("-Dfml.modFolders=")]
        if "-cp" in argv:
            position = argv.index("-cp") + 1
            root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
            argv[position] = ":".join(
                item
                for item in argv[position].split(":")
                if not item.startswith(str(root / "build/classes"))
                and not item.startswith(str(root / "build/resources"))
            )
        launch["argv"] = argv
    mode = (
        "native-control"
        if args.native_control
        else "without-dh"
        if args.without_dh
        else "dh"
    )
    receipt = attempt_receipt(args.receipt, Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], mode)
    profile = (args.profile or Path(launch["cwd"])).resolve(strict=True)
    if (profile / "shaderlod-functional.json").exists():
        raise ValueError(
            "earlier probe outputs remain in "
            + str(profile)
            + "; move shaderlod-functional* under "
            + str(evidence_root())
            + " before a new attempt"
        )
    environment = display_environment(args.display)
    environment.update(launch["environment"])
    with BusyRefusal(args.ownership_root, socket.gethostname() + ":gpu:0"):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        lock = json.loads((root / "dependencies/runtime.lock.json").read_bytes())
        mods = profile / "mods"
        mods.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        artifacts = {
            key: value
            for key, value in lock["artifacts"].items()
            if not (args.without_dh and key == "distanthorizons")
        }
        expected = {item["filename"] for item in artifacts.values()}
        shipping = None
        if args.shipping_jar is not None:
            payload = args.shipping_jar.read_bytes()
            name = args.shipping_jar.name
            expected.add(name)
            target = mods / name
            if target.exists():
                if target.is_symlink() or target.read_bytes() != payload:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "shipping profile JAR drift; preserve old artifact before replacement"
                    )
            else:
                target.write_bytes(payload)
            shipping = {"filename": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}

        if any(p.name not in expected for p in mods.iterdir()):
            raise ValueError(
                "unmanaged profile mod; preserve and resolve before launch"
            )
        for item in artifacts.values():
            payload = (root / "dependencies/runtime" / item["filename"]).read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != item["hashes"]["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("runtime mod identity disagreement")
            target = mods / item["filename"]
            if target.exists():
                if target.is_symlink() or target.read_bytes() != payload:
                    raise ValueError("profile mod drift")
            else:
                target.write_bytes(payload)
        before = executable_inputs(launch, root, profile)
        started = time.monotonic()
        with receipt.with_suffix(".log").open("xb") as log:
            worker = subprocess.Popen(
                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-m",
                    "shaderlod_host.worker",
                    str(time.monotonic() + args.timeout),
                    str(os.getpid()),
                    birth(os.getpid()),
                    json.dumps(argv),
                ],
                cwd=profile,
                env=worker_environment(environment),
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            )
            try:
                status = worker.wait(timeout=args.timeout + 5)
            finally:
                if worker.poll() is None:
                    worker.terminate()
                    worker.wait(timeout=3)
            functional = profile / "shaderlod-functional.json"
            observed, contract_error = read_functional(functional)
            if observed is not None:
                pin = json.loads((root / "dependencies/primary-pack.json").read_bytes())
                try:
                    observed = verify_functional(
                        observed,
                        profile,
                        pin["filename"],
                        pin["sha256"],
                        not args.without_dh,
                    )
                except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
                    contract_error = str(error)
            outputs = preserve_outputs(profile, receipt.with_suffix(""))
            result = {
                "schema": "shaderlod-live-attempt-v1",
                "platform": sys.platform,
                "scope": "live-functional only",
                "returncode": status,
                "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                "java_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(argv[0]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "launch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.launch.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "functional": observed,
                "dh_mode": "absent" if args.without_dh else "enabled",
                "native_control": args.native_control,
                "shipping_jar": shipping,
                "profile": str(profile),
                "outputs": {
                    "directory": str(receipt.with_suffix("")),
                    "sha256": outputs,
                },
                "executable_inputs": before,
                "inputs_unchanged": before == executable_inputs(launch, root, profile),
                "outcome": "PASS"
                if status == 0
                and observed is not None
                and observed.get("outcome") == "PASS"
                else "FAIL",
                "limits": "Advisory participating-owner exclusion; ambient occupancy must be checked before launch; no image-equivalence/performance qualification",
            }
            if contract_error is not None:
                result["outcome"] = "FAIL"
                result["contract_failure"] = contract_error
            if result["inputs_unchanged"] is not True:
                result["outcome"] = "FAIL"
                result["identity_failure"] = "Executable input drift"
            publish(receipt, result)
            print("RECEIPT: " + str(receipt))
            print(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        key: result[key]
                        for key in (
                            "schema",
                            "scope",
                            "outcome",
                            "returncode",
                            "elapsed_seconds",
                        )
                    },
                    sort_keys=True,
                )
            )
            return 0 if result["outcome"] == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


def prepare_windows_runtime(
    legacy: Path, canonical_profile: Path, root: Path
) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.storage import copytree, publish_bytes, replace_bytes

    if os.name != "nt":
        raise ValueError("native Windows preparation required")
    profile = root / "run-benchmark"
    copytree(canonical_profile, profile, 1073741824)
    python = root / "tools/python"
    copytree(legacy.parent / "tools/python", python, 268435456)
    for pth in python.glob("python*._pth"):
        replace_bytes(pth, pth.read_bytes() + b"\n" + str(root).encode() + b"\n")
    lock = json.loads((root / "dependencies/runtime.lock.json").read_bytes())
    mods = profile / "mods"
    mods.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for key, item in lock["artifacts"].items():
        if key == "distanthorizons":
            continue
        payload = (root / "dependencies/runtime" / item["filename"]).read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != item["hashes"]["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("runtime artifact hash mismatch")
        publish_bytes(mods / item["filename"], payload)
    pin = json.loads((root / "dependencies/primary-pack.json").read_bytes())
    pack = root / "dependencies/runtime" / pin["filename"]
    if hashlib.sha256(pack.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != pin["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("primary pack mismatch")
    publish_bytes(profile / "shaderpacks" / pin["filename"], pack.read_bytes())
    build = root / "build/moddev"
    build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jars = [
        line
        for line in (legacy / "build/moddev/clientLodOnLegacyClasspath.txt")
        .read_text()
        .splitlines()
        if line.lower().endswith(".jar")
    ]
    artifacts = legacy / "build/moddev/artifacts"
    jars = [
        str(artifacts / ("neoforge-" + lock["neoforge"] + suffix))
        for suffix in (".jar", "-client-extra-aka-minecraft-resources.jar")
    ] + jars
    if not jars or not all(Path(line).is_file() for line in jars):
        raise ValueError("legacy runtime dependencies unavailable")
    publish_bytes(
        build / "developmentLegacyClasspath.txt", ("\n".join(jars) + "\n").encode()
    )
    program = (
        (legacy / "build/moddev/clientLodOnRunProgramArgs.txt")
        .read_text()
        .split("# User Supplied Program Arguments")[0]
    )
    publish_bytes(
        build / "benchmarkRunProgramArgs.txt",
        (program + "\n--quickPlaySingleplayer\nShaderLOD-Smoke\n").encode(),
    )
    java = next((legacy.parent / "tools/java").glob("*/bin/java.exe"))
    classpaths = (
        [
            str(root / "build/classes/java" / name)
            for name in ("main", "devClient", "benchmarkCore")
        ]
        + [str(root / "build/resources" / name) for name in ("main", "devClient")]
        + jars
    )
    manifest: dict[str, object] = {
        "shipping_jar": str(root / "build/libs/shaderlod-0.1.0.jar"),
        "argv": [
            str(java),
            "@" + str(legacy / "build/moddev/clientLodOnRunVmArgs.txt"),
            "-Dfml.modFolders="
            + ";".join(
                mod + "%%" + str(root / suffix)
                for mod, suffix in [
                    ("shaderlod", "build/classes/java/main"),
                    ("shaderlod", "build/resources/main"),
                    ("shaderlod_dev", "build/classes/java/devClient"),
                    ("shaderlod_dev", "build/resources/devClient"),
                ]
            ),
            "-cp",
            ";".join(classpaths),
            "@" + str(build / "benchmarkRunProgramArgs.txt"),
        ],
        "cwd": str(profile),
        "environment": {},
    }
    publish(build / "windows-launch.json", manifest)
    return {
        "schema": "shaderlod-windows-preparation-v1",
        "launch": str(build / "windows-launch.json"),
        "profile": str(profile),
        "python": str(python / "python.exe"),
        "legacy_inputs_preserved": True,
    }


def repair_windows_classpath(legacy: Path, root: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.storage import replace

    launch_path = root / "build/moddev/windows-launch.json"
    launch = json.loads(launch_path.read_bytes())
    lock = json.loads((root / "dependencies/runtime.lock.json").read_bytes())
    expected = [
        str(
            legacy
            / "build/moddev/artifacts"
            / ("neoforge-" + lock["neoforge"] + suffix)
        )
        for suffix in (".jar", "-client-extra-aka-minecraft-resources.jar")
    ]
    if not all(Path(p).is_file() for p in expected):
        raise ValueError("matching native development artifacts unavailable")
    position = launch["argv"].index("-cp") + 1
    original = launch["argv"][position].split(";")
    launch["argv"][position] = ";".join(dict.fromkeys(expected + original))
    publish(
        root / "build/moddev/windows-launch-before-classpath-repair.json",
        json.loads(launch_path.read_bytes()),
    )
    replace(launch_path, launch)
    return {
        "schema": "shaderlod-native-classpath-repair-v1",
        "launch": str(launch_path),
        "added": expected,
    }


def execute_campaign(
    campaign: object,
    launch: Path,
    profile: Path,
    display: Path,
    ownership: Path,
    output: Path,
    world: str,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.assessment import assess
    from shaderlod_host.benchmark import session_command, wait_ready
    from shaderlod_host.campaign import Campaign
    from shaderlod_host.comparison import execute_comparison

    if not isinstance(campaign, Campaign) or output.exists():
        raise ValueError("decoded campaign and fresh output required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    publish(output / "campaign.json", campaign.wire())
    deadline = time.monotonic() + campaign.budget_ms / 1000
    runs = []
    failures = []
    for index, comparison in enumerate(campaign.comparisons):
        session = output / ("session-" + str(index + 1))
        allowance = (campaign.startup_ms + comparison.budget_ms) / 1000 + 15
        if time.monotonic() + allowance > deadline:
            failures.append(
                {
                    "session": index + 1,
                    "failure": "remaining campaign budget cannot admit complete planned session",
                }
            )
            break
        argv = [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "shaderlod_host",
            "session-open",
            "--launch",
            str(launch.resolve()),
            "--profile",
            str(profile.resolve()),
            "--display",
            str(display.resolve()),
            "--ownership-root",
            str(ownership.resolve()),
            "--session",
            str(session.resolve()),
            "--timeout",
            str(int(allowance)),
            "--world",
            world,
        ]
        with (output / ("launcher-" + str(index + 1) + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
            owner = subprocess.Popen(
                argv,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                env=worker_environment(),
            )
            try:
                ready_deadline = time.monotonic() + campaign.startup_ms / 1000
                while not (session / "session.json").exists():
                    if owner.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= ready_deadline:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "session startup failed or exhausted its fixed allowance"
                        )
                    time.sleep(0.05)
                wait_ready(session, max(0.1, ready_deadline - time.monotonic()))
                run = output / ("comparison-" + str(index + 1))
                result = execute_comparison(
                    comparison, session, run, policy=campaign.policy.wire()
                )
                runs.append(run / "result.json")
                if result["state"] != "complete":
                    raise ValueError(
                        "planned comparison incomplete; no automatic retry"
                    )
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                failures.append({"session": index + 1, "failure": str(error)})
            finally:
                if owner.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        session_command(
                            session,
                            "close",
                            0,
                            min(15, max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic())),
                        )
                    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
                        failures.append(
                            {"session": index + 1, "close_failure": str(error)}
                        )
                        owner.terminate()
                try:
                    owner.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    owner.kill()
                    owner.wait(timeout=3)
                    failures.append(
                        {
                            "session": index + 1,
                            "close_failure": "supervisor forced down; inspect recovery journals",
                        }
                    )
            if failures:
                break
    assessment = assess(campaign.policy, runs) if runs else None
    result = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-campaign-result-v1",
        "state": "complete"
        if len(runs) == len(campaign.comparisons) and not failures
        else "incomplete",
        "runs": [str(path.relative_to(output)) for path in runs],
        "failures": failures,
        "assessment": assessment,
        "quality": "required separately; no automatic acceptance",
    }
    publish(output / "result.json", result)
    return result


def freeze_windows_runtime(legacy: Path, output: Path, root: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    from shaderlod_host.storage import publish_bytes, replace_bytes

    if os.name != "nt" or output.exists() or output.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("fresh external native Windows runtime destination required")
    manifest_path = root / "build/moddev/windows-launch.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())
    legacy = legacy.resolve(strict=True)
    argv = list(manifest["argv"])
    old_classpath = (root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt").read_text()
    sources = {Path(item) for item in argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1].split(os.pathsep)}
    sources.update(Path(item) for item in old_classpath.splitlines() if item)
    copied = {}
    total = sum(
        p.stat().st_size for p in sources if p.is_file() and p.is_relative_to(legacy)
    )
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if shutil.disk_usage(output.parent).free < total + 1073741824:
        raise ValueError("insufficient capacity for runtime snapshot and reserve")
    output.mkdir()
    for path in sorted(sources):
        if path.is_relative_to(legacy):
            target = output / path.relative_to(legacy)
            payload = path.read_bytes()
            publish_bytes(target, payload)
            copied[str(target)] = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

    def relocated(text: str) -> str:
        return text.replace(str(legacy), str(output)).replace(
            legacy.as_posix(), output.as_posix()
        )

    argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1] = relocated(argv[argv.index("-cp") + 1])
    vm = next(Path(item[1:]) for item in argv if item.startswith("@"))
    base_vm = vm.read_text().split("# User JVM Arguments")[0]
    logging = legacy / "build/moddev/clientLodOnLog4j2.xml"
    publish_bytes(output / "logging.xml", logging.read_bytes())
    new_vm = output / "vm-args.txt"
    entries = [
        base_vm,
        "-Xmx6G",
        "-Dlog4j2.configurationFile=" + (output / "logging.xml").as_posix(),
        "-Djava.net.preferIPv6Addresses=system",
        "-DignoreList=mixinextras-neoforge-0.5.3.jar,client-extra,neoforge-",
        "-DlegacyClassPath.file="
        + (root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt").as_posix(),
    ]
    publish_bytes(new_vm, ("\n".join(entries) + "\n").encode())
    argv[argv.index("@" + str(vm))] = "@" + str(new_vm)
    manifest["argv"] = argv
    manifest["runtime_snapshot"] = str(output)
    serialized = json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True).encode()
    if (
        str(legacy).encode() in serialized
        or str(legacy).encode() in new_vm.read_bytes()
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "source checkout dependency remains; snapshot preserved without changing launch"
        )
    publish_bytes(output / "previous-launch.json", manifest_path.read_bytes())
    publish_bytes(output / "previous-legacy-classpath.txt", old_classpath.encode())
    replace_bytes(
        root / "build/moddev/developmentLegacyClasspath.txt",
        relocated(old_classpath).encode(),
    )
    replace_bytes(manifest_path, serialized)
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "schema": "shaderlod-windows-runtime-snapshot-v1",
        "files": copied,
        "copied_bytes": total,
        "runtime": str(output),
        "launch_sha256": hashlib.sha256(serialized).hexdigest(),
        "shared_dependencies": "Existing user-owned toolchain and Gradle artifact cache outside the original source checkout remain referenced",
    }
    publish(output / "manifest.json", record)
    return record
